item.title: Correction · Uber Mission Bay 1: OpenAI was shown as open at 1455 3rd St on the strength of a 2023 SF Standard report of a signed lease; it now shows the tenant as announced with no opening date. Uber was shown as open since June 2020 based only on a DataSF business registration that predates the building's completion, at a building later subleased to OpenAI; that tenant listing was removed, and the related timeline entry now describes it as a registration. The completion milestone said June 2021 with only a website's home page as its source; ArchDaily gives 2022, so it now reads 2022 (the status notes say the same, and that the Assessor has no year built). A pile-driver milestone sourced only to a website's home page was removed. The joint venture (Alexandria 51%, Uber 49%, formed September 2014) now cites Alexandria's 3Q14 supplemental, which also calls the two buildings Class A. The OpenAI lease milestone cites the SF Standard and Real Deal articles.
item.description: OpenAI was shown as open at 1455 3rd St on the strength of a 2023 SF Standard report of a signed lease; it now shows the tenant as announced with no opening date. A pile-driver milestone sourced only to a website's home page was removed. item.title: Added · Uber Mission Bay 1: SF Standard reported on 2023-10-27 that OpenAI is leasing two buildings at 1455 and 1515 Third St from Uber, described as the largest office lease in San Francisco since 2018. The article reports the lease, not an operating office.

item.title: Added · Uber Mission Bay 1: DataSF Registered Business Locations lists Uber Technologies Inc at 1455 3rd St with a location start date of 2020-06-25.
